Seeking Business Analyst/Consultant Role in Product development Sector with an organization of high repute and to expand my career growth.
SYNOPSIS
Business Analyst / Product Owner with 10+ years of experience across Banking, Financial Services, Payments Operations and FinTech, with strong experience in business requirements, process transformation, AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, BPMN process modelling, workflow optimization and Agile product delivery. Experienced in supporting end-to-end operating model transformation, analyzing current-state processes, identifying business and operational gaps, and defining future-state workflows to support process improvement, automation and digital transformation. Experienced in working with global distributed teams and cross-functional stakeholders across Business, Technology, Operations, Finance and Risk functions.
HIGHLIGHTS
➢ Hands-on experience in working with the Client during UAT 
➢ Proficient in Client interacting ➢ Experience in Preparing the BRD Documents
